### 🟡 Changes recommended Unused imports in the GreyNoise and URLScan TLP reset tests trigger F401 under CI’s flake8 configuration, causing the lint check to fail.
2 open issues - [Remove unused test imports flagged by CI lint](https://github.com/OpenCTI-Platform/connectors/pull/8397#discussion_r4570749912) · New - [Remove unused OpenCTIConnectorHelper import](https://github.com/OpenCTI-Platform/connectors/pull/8397#discussion_r4570749974) · New
What changed in this PR Extends the first-epss fix from #8385 to six enrichment connectors and the template, addressing #8386. Unmarked entities no longer inherit a previous message’s TLP and get incorrectly refused. **Changes:** - Reset stored TLP before checking each entity’s markings. - Add regression tests for a refused TLP:RED entity followed by an accepted unmarked entity. - Add test setup and dependencies for RiskIQ PassiveTotal. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `templates/​internal-enrichment/​src/​connector/​connector.py` | Reset TLP in the enrichment template. | | `internal-enrichment/​urlscan-enrichment/​tests/​tests_connector/​test_tlp_reset.py` | Add consecutive-message regression test. | | `internal-enrichment/​urlscan-enrichment/​src/​urlscan_enrichment_services/​connector.py` | Reset TLP before checking markings. | | `internal-enrichment/​team-cymru-scout/​tests/​tests_connector/​test_tlp_reset.py` | Add consecutive-message regression test. | | `internal-enrichment/​team-cymru-scout/​src/​pure_signal_scout/​connector.py` | Reset TLP before checking markings. | | `internal-enrichment/​team-cymru-scout-search/​tests/​tests_connector/​test_tlp_reset.py` | Add consecutive-message regression test. | | `internal-enrichment/​team-cymru-scout-search/​src/​scout_search_connector/​connector.py` | Reset TLP before checking markings. | | `internal-enrichment/​riskiq-passive-total/​tests/​tests_connector/​test_tlp_reset.py` | Add consecutive-message regression test. | | `internal-enrichment/​riskiq-passive-total/​tests/​test-requirements.txt` | Declare test dependencies. | | `internal-enrichment/​riskiq-passive-total/​tests/​conftest.py` | Make connector source importable in tests. | | `internal-enrichment/​riskiq-passive-total/​src/​riskiq_passive_total/​connector.py` | Reset TLP before checking markings. | | `internal-enrichment/​malbeacon/​tests/​tests_connector/​test_tlp_reset.py` | Add consecutive-message regression test. | | `internal-enrichment/​malbeacon/​src/​main.py` | Reset TLP before checking markings. | | `internal-enrichment/​greynoise/​tests/​tests_connector/​test_tlp_reset.py` | Add consecutive-message regression test. | | `internal-enrichment/​greynoise/​src/​connector/​connector.py` | Reset TLP before checking markings. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: `MagicMock` and `OpenCTIConnectorHelper` are both unused in this test module. The Base Linter job runs `flake8 --ignore=E,W .` (`.github/workflows/ci-lint-format.yml:68`), which overrides the ignore list in `.flake8` and enables F401, so these imports fail that CI check. Please remove both imports.

`OpenCTIConnectorHelper` is unused here; the production method calls it directly, so the test does not need this import. CI runs `flake8 --ignore=E,W .` (`.github/workflows/ci-lint-format.yml:68`), overriding the configured F401 suppression, so this import fails the lint check. Please remove it.
